rotation_note: tidally locked with Pluto (synchronous orbit; same face always toward Pluto)
coverage_note: PARTIAL COVERAGE: New Horizons (July 2015 flyby) imaged ~46% of Charon. Encounter hemisphere (~0-180E, Pluto-facing side) has real topographic data; unimaged terrain (far side ~180-360E, 54.4% of source pixels) sits at reference level 0 and renders as featureless 'ocean'. (43,794,826/80,562,471 source pixels were nodata/unimaged)
source: NASA New Horizons mission, LORRI/MVIC instruments; Charon New Horizons Global DEM 300m July 2017, public domain
